mapper.select: SELECT id, username, status FROM sys_user WHERE create_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND status = '1'
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET status = '0' WHERE last_login_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content FROM notes WHERE DATE(created_at) = '2023-10-01'
SELECT n.id, n.title, u.username FROM notes n LEFT JOIN users u ON n.user_id = u.id
SELECT n.title, nb.title FROM notes n, notebooks nb
SELECT id, title, content FROM notes WHERE notebook_id = '1024'
SELECT id, title, content FROM notes ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500000, 20
SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE title LIKE '工作日志%'
SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content FROM notes n WHERE n.user_id IN ( SELECT id FROM users WHERE status = 1 ) AND DATE_FORMAT(n.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') = '2023-10-01'
SELECT n.title, u.username, t.tag_name FROM notes n, users u, tags t, note_tags nt WHERE n.user_id = u.id AND t.id = nt.tag_id AND u.status = '1' -- 故意漏写了 n.id = nt.note_id

SELECT u.username, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE user_id = u.id) as note_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE user_id = u.id) as comment_count FROM users u HAVING note_count > 0 AND comment_count > 0
